blocks.text: Greedy (laalchi) algorithms ek ke baad ek kai choices (faisle) karte hain; har faisla us waqt ke hisab se sab se behtar (locally optimal) hota hai, is umeed par ke yeh faisle mil kar poore masle ka sab se behtar (globally optimal) hal denge. Greedy tareeqa aksar tab istemal hota hai jab masle mein optimal substructure ho, yani poore masle ka behtareen hal us ke chhote hisson (sub problems) ke behtareen hal se banaya ja sake.

Misal: greedy algorithm ki mashhoor misal Coin Change problem hai. Farz karein aap ke paas alag alag qeemat (denominations) ke sikke hain aur aap ko kam se kam sikkon mein ek khaas raqam banani hai. Greedy algorithm har dafa woh sab se bara sikka chunta hai jo baqi raqam se zyada na ho, phir us ki qeemat baqi raqam se ghata deta hai, aur yahi dohrata hai jab tak chahi gayi raqam poori na ho jaye.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Misal (hamari taraf se): 1, 2, 5 aur 10 ke sikkon se 18 banana: 10 lo (baqi 8), 5 lo (baqi 3), 2 lo (baqi 1), 1 lo (baqi 0). Kul chaar sikke: 18 = 10 + 5 + 2 + 1.

Yeh program greedy tareeqe se har dafa sab se bara munasib sikka leta hai. amount badal kar Run karein. Phir coins = [4, 3, 1] aur amount = 6 kar ke dekhein: greedy teen sikke deta hai, jabke 3 + 3 sirf do hain.

coins = [10, 5, 2, 1]   # coin values
amount = 18

def greedy_change(left):
    used = []
    for coin in sorted(coins, reverse=True):    # biggest coin first
        while coin <= left:
            used.append(coin)
            left = left - coin
            print("Take", coin, "-> left", left)
    return used, left

used, left = greedy_change(amount)
print("Coins used:", used, "| count:", len(used))
if left > 0:
    print("Exact amount not possible; left over:", left)

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"coins = [10, 5, 2, 1]" aur "amount = 18": kaun se sikke (coins) hain aur kitni raqam deni hai.
"def greedy_change(left):": left woh raqam hai jo abhi deni baqi hai.
"for coin in sorted(coins, reverse=True):": sikke bare se chhote ki tarteeb mein; greedy (lalchi) tareeqa hamesha sab se bara pehle leta hai.
"while coin <= left:": jab tak yeh sikka baqi raqam mein samata hai, use lete raho.
"used.append(coin)" aur "left = left - coin": sikka list mein jorta hai aur raqam kam karta hai; har dafa "Take ..." print hota hai.
"if left > 0:": aakhir mein bhi raqam bache to bata deta hai ke poori raqam nahi ban saki.
Output: "Take 10 -> left 8", "Take 5 -> left 3", "Take 2 -> left 1", "Take 1 -> left 0", phir "Coins used: [10, 5, 2, 1] | count: 4".
Khud try karein: coins = [4, 3, 1] aur amount = 6 kar ke Run karein: greedy [4, 1, 1] yani 3 sikke deta hai, jabke 3 + 3 sirf 2 sikke hain; greedy hamesha optimal (sab se behtar) nahi.

blocks.title: Tidbits
blocks.text: Greedy algorithms aksar doosri techniques se tez aur banane mein aasan hote hain, magar har masle mein sab se behtar (optimal) hal ki guarantee (pakka wada) nahi dete. Hamesha masle ko ghaur se dekhein taake yaqeen ho ke greedy tareeqa munasib hai.

blocks.prompt: 1, 3 aur 4 ke sikkon se 6 banana ho to greedy tareeqa kya deta hai, aur behtareen jawab kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Greedy pehle 4 leta hai, phir 1 aur 1: teen sikke (4 + 1 + 1). Magar 3 + 3 sirf do sikke hain. Yani yahan greedy behtareen hal nahi deta.

blocks.prompt: Greedy algorithms ka basic khayal bataiye (short question 4).
blocks.explanation: Har qadam par woh faisla lein jo abhi sab se behtar lage aur us par wapas na jayein, is umeed par ke local (us waqt ke) behtareen faisle mil kar poora behtareen hal denge. Yeh tez aur aasan hai, magar sirf optimal substructure wale maslon par hamesha behtareen hal deta hai.

items: Greedy: har qadam par abhi ka behtareen faisla, wapsi nahi.
Coin change: 18 = 10 + 5 + 2 + 1; magar hamesha behtareen nahi (1, 3, 4 se 6).
